question: Oda-sensei! Heso! Among the nine Vice Admirals heading to Egghead is a character who looks like Rear Admiral Kadar, who appeared in the Fish-Man Island Arc in the past! Has he been promoted? Also, please tell us the profiles of the other Vice Admirals!
answer: Rear Admiral Kadar does look similar, but he's a different person. This one is Hound. Sorry for the rough introduction, but I'll introduce the characters other than Vice Admiral Doberman, who's been around for a long time. Top row, from left to right: *Vice Admiral Pomsky. (Rako Rako no Mi, Sea Otter Human) Uses powerful blows with a shell. *Vice Admiral Doll. Fist fighter (Soul of Rock). *Vice Admiral Tosa. Bites with his hands (Tosa-Ken). *Vice Admiral Urban. (Tsutsu Tsutsu no Mi, Cannon Human) The top of his head is a cannon. Bottom row, from left to right: *Vice Admiral Bluegrass. (Nori Nori no Mi, Piloting Human) "Great Staff Officer" Tsuru's sworn older sister. She can use any living thing or object within the range of her Haki as a vehicle. *Vice Admiral Hound. (Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Hound) Contemporaries with Smoker. *Vice Admiral Red King. He can shoot his right knuckle using the power of a steam engine. *Vice Admiral Guillotine. The knife on his head flies like a boomerang.
name: Ma-chan
